parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Silver is a transition element. Sodium is in Group I of the Periodic Table. State one diﬀerence in the physical properties of silver and sodium. .............................................................................................................................................. [1]

ms.label: 6(c)
ms.text:
any one of:
•
silver has high density / sodium has low density
•
silver has high(er) melting point / sodium has low(er) melting point
•
silver forms coloured compounds / (most) sodium compounds are not coloured

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Table 6.2 shows the observations when four diﬀerent metals are heated in oxygen. Table 6.2 metal observations when heated in oxygen cerium burns rapidly and forms an oxide copper forms an oxide layer very slowly and does not burn lanthanum forms an oxide layer rapidly and does not burn silver does not form an oxide layer and does not burn Put the four metals in order of their reactivity. Put the least reactive metal ﬁrst. least reactive most reactive [2]

ms.label: 6(d)
ms.text:
silver < copper < lanthanum < cerium (2)
if two marks not scored: one mark for one pair reversed OR reverse order
